extDescription.message: Hover to identify React/MUI components and jump to their source, with a lightweight render/performance debugger.

popupToggleInspect.message: Toggle inspect mode on this tab

labelMuiSkip.message: Skip MUI internals and jump to your own code

hintTarget.message: Only localhost / 127.0.0.1 dev servers. Settings save automatically.

hintConfigureShortcuts.message: Opens chrome://extensions/shortcuts to remap Alt+Shift+I / Alt+Shift+R to any keys.

inspectOn.message: Inspect ON — Click: editor / Alt+Click: owner tree / ↑↓: parent/child / Esc: exit

inspectOnSafe.message: Inspect ON — no dev build detected, safe mode (names only / Esc to exit)

jumpUnresolved.message: Could not resolve source location (React 19 may need the Babel source plugin)

jumpProd.message: Source jump is unavailable on production builds

editorLinkOff.message: Editor link is off (toggle it in the popup). Alt+Click still opens the owner tree.

renderOn.message: Render viz ON — re-rendered elements flash (blue→red = more frequent) / R: record / toggle again to exit

renderOnNoDev.message: Render viz ON — no dev build detected, timing unavailable (flash only)

recordStart.message: Recording — interact to trigger re-renders, press R to stop and see the ranking

statsColsSupported.message: Columns: component / re-renders / cumulative self time (ms)

statsColsUnsupported.message: Profiler timer unavailable here; time shows 0 (needs a dev build)
